name: cli-session-operator
body: The operator of a durable-spec authoring session in a project worktree: a navigator agent or a maintainer who opens one CLI session, issues a series of durable node/edge mutations through it, chooses the moment the accumulated change becomes durable, and then ends or abandons the session. They drive the session through `apg session start|save|end|abort` and the `apg_session` suite tool. Their interest is a run of spec edits that lands as a single durable commit, and an abandoned run that leaves the durable spec and the derived index at their last saved state.
